There is no blanket ban on high ABV beers in the UK, we do brew plenty of our own. The problem is with certain local authorities who are banning the sale of high ABV beers in a misguided attempt to tackle what they see as problem drinkers, like street drinkers who tend to favour cheap 8-10% super strength lager (Malt Liqueur).
